    AI Overview
    Atlético Madrid secured a 2-0 victory against 10-man FC Barcelona in their April 8, 2026 Champions League quarter-final first-leg match at Camp Nou, with goals from Julian Alvarez and Alexander Sorloth. This win ended Atlético's 25-visit winless streak at Camp Nou (since 2006). Overall, historically, FC Barcelona holds the advantage over Atlético with 115 wins to 80. 
    Recent Match Highlights (April 8, 2026 - Champions League) 
    • Result: FC Barcelona 0-2 Atlético Madrid
    • Venue: Spotify Camp Nou
    • Key Action: Pau Cubarsí (Barcelona) received a red card in the 42nd minute.
    • Goalscorers: Julián Alvarez (45') and Alexander Sørloth (70'). 
    Key Head-to-Head Statistics 
    • Overall Record (Total Clashes): 252 meetings, 115 wins for Barcelona, 80 for Atlético, 57 draws.
    • Recent Form: Prior to this 2026 UCL quarter-final, Barcelona had dominated recent matchups, including winning seven of the last 10 meetings.
    • 2025-26 La Liga Standings: As of early April 2026, Barcelona was 1st in the league with 76 points, while Atlético was 4th with 54 points, according to. 
    Historical Significance 
    • This was Atlético's first win at Camp Nou since February 2006.
    • Barcelona had not failed to score in a home match for 40 matches, dating back to December 2024, prior to this match.
